arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the current polished mermaid sprite to edit. Image 2 is the exact original pose guide. Image 3 supplies the established green fish-tail transition and Image 4 supplies the established water-ripple treatment. She clearly disliked what she just ate. Replace the cheerful smile with a closed mouth and an unmistakable expression of disapproval: lips pressed or slightly downturned, brows tense, and eyes reacting with displeasure. Do not show teeth and do not smile. Preserve the two empty forward hand gestures and their different heights. Extend her lower torso slightly farther out of the water so her abdomen and bellybutton are visible, followed by only the beginning of the green scaled fish tail; put a narrow blue water ripple at the tail/fin level below the bellybutton. Do not draw a full tail. Preserve her identity, hair, headband, swimsuit, arm anatomy, bold black ink, cel shading, and genuine RGBA transparency. No food prop, backdrop, text, border, or extra objects.
